name: for elise ~Elise no Tame ni~
original_name: for elise ～エリーゼのために～
source:
A normal office worker is in love with his co-worker, but he is too shy to tell her. Being hit by a ball in the head changed him, at least in his dreams. He started to have bad dreams of punishing girls that interfere with his love.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
